_comment: Where places.json came from and when it was built. The 47 MB CSV is not tracked; the
build is reproducible from `url`, and `sha256` (of the zip) is what says whether a later
download is the same edition. `built` is a stored date and nothing in CI compares it to
today; the bus-work worklist ages a row from it.
dataset: Index of Place Names in Great Britain
publisher: Office for National Statistics (Open Geography Portal)
